name: Drugs for Asthma, COPD and Cough

reference.source: KD Tripathi Essentials of Medical Pharmacology 8th Edition and Kaplan Pharmacology (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Inhaled corticosteroids are the asthma controller foundation
LABA must never be used without ICS in asthma
Rinse mouth after ICS to prevent oral candidiasis
COPD: LAMA/LABA first; ICS reserved for selected exacerbators
reference.pathophysiology: Type 2 airway inflammation with eosinophils, IgE and cytokines narrows bronchi through smooth muscle spasm, mucosal oedema and mucus, all reversible early and remodelled late. Beta agonists relax muscle within minutes while steroids transcriptionally suppress inflammation over days, and biologics interrupt single cytokine pathways in biomarker defined severe disease. COPD adds fixed obstruction and emphysema where bronchodilation dominates.
additionalDifferentials: Reliever versus controller roles in asthma
Theophylline versus modern add on therapies
additionalInvestigations: Blood eosinophils, IgE and exhaled nitric oxide phenotyping
